Coordinates of the Swiss cities

pv_city_coords.Rd

One point per city of pv_city_population: the WGS84 centroid of the city's municipal territory, computed from the BFS GG25 boundary polygons (generalisation level G1, status 1 January 2025) in the metric LV95 plane and then reprojected. The demo companion for point and bubble maps — join it to pv_city_population by city.

Usage

pv_city_coords

Format

A data frame with 180 rows: city (matches pv_city_population), id (the official BFS municipality number, the same key the boundary layers use), lon, lat (WGS84 degrees, rounded to 4 decimals, ~11 m).

Source

Derived from Bundesamt für Statistik, "Generalisierte Gemeindegrenzen" (GG25). Open use, source citation required ("© BFS, ThemaKart").
